A capacitor $C$ charged to voltage $U_0$ is connected to an identical uncharged capacitor. What fraction of the system's energy remains?
questions.e: The voltage becomes $U_0/2$: $2\cdot\tfrac12C(U_0/2)^2=\tfrac14CU_0^2$, i.e. half of the initial value.
